_about: Inside the Machine – all level content and hotspot coordinates. Coordinates are in each scene SVG viewBox units (origin top-left).

objects.name: Tablet
objects.msg: Chip found! A tablet is a computer you can hold in your hands.

objects.name: Smartwatch
objects.msg: Chip found! A smartwatch is a tiny computer you wear.

objects.name: Pop-up toaster
objects.msg: No chip. This pop-up toaster just uses heat to make toast.

objects.name: Book
objects.msg: No chip. A book is made of paper, not computer parts.

objects.name: Phone
objects.msg: Chip found! A phone is a computer that fits in your pocket.

pins.label: Monitor
pins.hint: I show words, pictures and videos. I look like a small TV.

pins.label: System unit
pins.hint: I am the box that holds the brain of the computer.

pins.label: Keyboard
pins.hint: I have lots of keys. Press them to type letters and numbers.

pins.label: Mouse
pins.hint: Move me to point at things on the screen, then click to choose.

pins.label: Speakers
pins.hint: I let you hear music and sounds.

level2_deskSetup.note: x,y are % of scene; xPx,yPx are viewBox units

slots.name: Power supply (PSU)
slots.clue: I take electricity from the wall socket and give power to every part.
slots.yay: Power supply is in! It gives power to every part.

slots.name: Motherboard
slots.clue: I am the big main board. All the other parts plug into me.
slots.yay: Motherboard is in! Look, new spaces appeared on it. Other parts plug into the motherboard.

slots.name: RAM
slots.clue: I hold what you are working on right now. I forget it all when the power goes off.
slots.yay: RAM is in! It holds what you are working on right now.

slots.name: Cooling fan
slots.clue: I spin round and round to stop the computer from getting too hot.
slots.yay: Cooling fan is in! It keeps the computer from getting too hot.

slots.name: Hard disk (HDD)
slots.clue: I keep your files and photos safe, even when the computer is switched off.
slots.yay: Hard disk is in! It stores your files even when the power is off.

slots.name: Graphics card
slots.clue: I help draw pictures, videos and games on the monitor.
slots.yay: Graphics card is in! It helps show pictures and games.

level3_xray.rule: Slots with sub=true appear only after the motherboard is placed.

riddles.q: I am a tiny camera above the screen. I see you in video calls. What am I?
Slide your finger on me to move the pointer. What am I?
Plug a pen drive into me to save your work. What am I?
Music and sounds come out of my tiny holes. What am I?
Press me to switch the phone on or off. What am I?
Plug the charger into me when the battery is low. What am I?
Smile! I take selfies. What am I?
Say hello! I listen to your voice during a call. What am I?

devices.name: Keyboard
devices.why: You type on it to put letters into the computer.

devices.name: Mouse
devices.why: You move and click it to give the computer instructions.

devices.name: Microphone
devices.why: It takes your voice into the computer.

devices.name: Webcam
devices.why: It sends pictures of you into the computer.

devices.name: Monitor
devices.why: It shows you what the computer is doing.

devices.name: Printer
devices.why: It puts your work out onto paper.

devices.name: Speakers
devices.why: Sound comes out of them for everyone to hear.

devices.name: Headphones
devices.why: Sound comes out of them just for you.

devices.name: Wi-Fi router
devices.why: It shares the internet with devices using Wi-Fi.

devices.name: Network cable
devices.why: It joins a computer to a network.

devices.name: Modem
devices.why: It brings the internet into a building.

frame.layout: Top bar 58 px; body padding 12 px; side panel 260 px; play area 834 x 420 px. Frame scales uniformly to fit the window.

events.tap: buttons, level track, tapping a device part
events.pickup: picking up or selecting a draggable item
events.drop: any drop onto a target, before the result
events.scan: Level 1 scan sweep, 0.8 s, stops if scanner moves off
events.reveal: Level 3 new slots appear; Level 4 phone arrives; badge screen opens
events.all-complete: fanfare when the fifth level is finished
